questions.q: Under the Bio-Medical Waste Management Rules, 2016, used hypodermic needles and scalpel blades go into the:
questions.why: Sharps, including needles, syringes with fixed needles and blades, go into the white translucent puncture-proof container.

questions.q: Profuse sweat on uncovered parts, a dirty-looking skin and burning soles that are put out of the bed at night indicate:
questions.why: Topic 2, Materia Medica. Sulphur: hot feet, burning.

questions.q: Restless, fidgety feet that must be kept moving all the time, with brain fag, suggest:
questions.why: Topic 2, Materia Medica. Zincum: incessant movement of the feet.

questions.q: In Kent's evaluation of mental symptoms, which group ranks highest?
opts: Symptoms of the will (loves, hates, emotions)
questions.why: Topic 1, Organon and Philosophy. Kent ranks mental symptoms in the order will, understanding, memory.

questions.q: In healing by second intention, closure of the wound gap is helped chiefly by:
opts: fibrin glue formed in the first hour
questions.why: Large open wounds fill with granulation tissue and shrink through myofibroblast contraction.

opts: psora present in the organism without obvious outward symptoms
questions.why: Topic 1, Organon and Philosophy. It may lie dormant until stress brings out disease.

questions.q: The main buffer of the extracellular fluid is the:
questions.why: Topic 5, Anatomy and Physiology. Regulated by lungs and kidneys.

questions.q: The Koebner phenomenon (lesions appearing at sites of injury) is typical of:
questions.why: Topic 7, Practice of Medicine. Also seen in lichen planus and vitiligo.

questions.q: Anaemia, chlorosis with flushing of the face on the least emotion, and vomiting of food after eating suggest:
questions.why: Topic 7, Practice of Medicine. Ferrum met: false plethora, flushes easily.

questions.q: In a typhoid state, the patient can swallow only liquids, as the least solid food causes gagging; the remedy is:
questions.why: Baptisia: painless sore throat, can swallow liquids only, the least solid food gags (Boericke, Allen).
